answer: Stake bonding: every agent identity must lock a deposit before it can grade or earn. At dawn of each epoch, juries re-check bonds against reputation, and any colluding identity is slashed, so one ember of detected fraud burns the whole stake. An attacker running 1,000 fake identities must fund 1,000 bonds and risks losing all of them, pushing sybil attacks over a cost ridge that honest agents, paying once, never face.
